hints.content:
The function is decreasing, so the left Riemann sum will overestimate the actual area:

![The graph of function f has the shaded area divided into 5 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/0bdbb304e2345c8ef5e889a059625a8e667eeb9c)

And the right Riemann sum will underestimate:

![The graph of function f has the shaded area divided into 5 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/7dbe996cdf034f850c19b5cb8a2d4616bbe1654e)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Right Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Left Riemann sum
